name: Processed single-cell Raman spectra and analysis data for ORU-guided identification of urinary tract infection pathogens
description: This dataset supports the study “Operational Raman unit-guided database construction for culture-free single-cell Raman identification of urinary tract infection pathogens.” It contains processed Raman feature data, figure source tables, per-spectrum predictions, fixed training and assessment membership, and R scripts for within-ORU resampling and source-group-clustered uncertainty analyses. The ORU assessment is retrospective and label-informed. The README describes file contents, analysis dependencies, and reproducibility limitations. Raw clinical spectral files and the internal code key are not included.
